jobs.title: Directeur des opérations (F/H)
jobs.description: Vous souhaitez diriger un site industriel, faire progresser la performance et fédérer des équipes dans un environnement technique exigeant ? Vous recherchez un poste de direction alliant pilotage opérationnel, management, amélioration continue et conduite de projets de transformation ? Rejoignez nous ! JACIR - société du groupe COFINAIR qui regroupe 4 sites production en France, en Allemagne et en Italie, 290 personnes pour 70M€ CA – se positionne aujourd’hui comme le partenaire incontournable Européen en proposant des technologies innovantes de refroidissement évaporatif respectueuses de l’environnement : design, fabrication, commercialisation, Services dédiés aux tours de refroidissement et refroidisseurs adiabatiques pour l’industrie et le tertiaire. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Directeur des opérations. Garant(e) de la performance du site, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la production, de la maintenance et de la Supply Chain, et conduisez les projets de transformation qui soutiendront la croissance de JACIR. Vous exercez ces responsabilités dans un cadre exigeant, où la sécurité, la qualité et la conformité aux référentiels MASE, ISO 9001 et ISO 19443 sont au cœur de chaque décision. Ce poste est basé à notre site d’Hautot-sur-Mer puis Criquetot-sur-Longueville (76) : Missions : • Diriger l'ensemble des activités de production du site et en garantir la performance globale : coûts, qualité, délais, productivité et satisfaction client. • Garantir la sécurité des personnes, la conformité réglementaire et l'ancrage de la culture QHSE, dans le respect des référentiels MASE, ISO 9001 et ISO 19443. • Assurer la fabrication et la livraison des produits conformément aux exigences clients et aux standards du groupe. • Piloter la planification, les méthodes, la maintenance, la Supply Chain et les démarches d'amélioration continue. • Élaborer et suivre les budgets, les investissements et les indicateurs de performance du site.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Marketing - Video Creation & Social Media (m/w/d)
jobs.description: DARE TO BE DIFFERENT. Du denkst in Kamera, Schnitt und Story? Du fühlst dich im 9:16 Format zuhause und weißt, was ein gutes Reel braucht, damit man nicht nach drei Sekunden weiterscrollt? Du kannst aus einer Idee ein fertiges Video machen und hast Lust, mit KI, Animationen und neuen Formaten zu experimentieren? Dann könnte das hier ziemlich gut passen! Wir sind JAMORIE, ein junges Cybersecurity Unternehmen aus Frankfurt. Wir wissen, Cybersecurity kann trocken sein. Gleichzeitig ist das Thema sehr wichtig und Unternehmen müssen verstehen, welche Gefahren sie digital ausgesetzt sind und wie sie sich davor schützen können. Dein Job ist es, daraus verständlichen Content zu machen, der im Kopf bleibt und die richtigen Zielgruppen erreicht. Seriös genug für den B2B Kontext. Spannend genug für Social Media. Dafür suchen wir DICH als Werkstudent Marketing - Video Creation & Social Media Deine Aufgaben Du produzierst nicht einfach Videos nach Vorlage. Du entwickelst Formate, setzt sie eigenständig um und denkst darüber nach, wie sie bei unserer Zielgruppe ankommen. Video-Produktion & Editing: Du drehst regelmäßig Videos, schneidest sie und bereitest sie für Instagram, TikTok und YouTube auf. Dafür planen wir etwa einen Produktionstag pro Monat in Frankfurt, an dem du Content für die kommenden Wochen produzierst. Content-Ideen & Storytelling: Du überlegst dir eigene Ideen für Hooks, Videoformate und Stories, die neugierig machen und komplexe Themen verständlich vermitteln. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence. Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including: Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI. HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC. HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC. Colorectal Cancer (CRC) HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy. Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland. Overview of Role:   The Senior Specialist

jobs.title: Prescriptions Support Coordinator
jobs.description: At Montu, we are on a mission to transform access to medical cannabis treatment across the UK, and we are growing fast! We are looking for a Prescription Support Coordinator to join our team in King's Cross, London. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy, fast-paced environment, has exceptional attention to detail and enjoys being part of a team that makes a genuine difference to patients' lives. You do not need previous pharmacy experience. What matters most is your ability to work accurately, stay organised and bring a positive, proactive approach to everything you do. If you are looking to be part of an ambitious, growing business where your work really matters, we would love to hear from you! About the Role As a Prescription Support Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting our prescription operations, ensuring patient requests are reviewed accurately, processed efficiently and managed in line with our established procedures. You will be responsible for reviewing a high volume of prescription requests, contacting patients to discuss alternative prescription quantities and ensuring their preferences are accurately recorded. Working closely with our clinical and operational teams, you will help keep our prescription processes running smoothly while delivering a positive and professional patient experience. This is a fast-paced, process-driven role that requires excellent attention to detail, consistency and the ability to maintain accuracy when completing repetitive tasks. While you will not be making clinical decisions, you will need the confidence to recognise when something requires clinical input and escalate appropriately. What You Will Be Doing Reviewing and processing a high volume of prescription requests, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established procedures. Contacting patients by telephone, email or messaging platforms to discuss alternative prescription quantities and accurately record their preferences.

jobs.description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. jobs.title: Partner-Manager:in Lernprogramme
jobs.description: Worum es geht Mit Coachweave macht die Teachlume GmbH aus dem Wissen von Coaches, Trainer:innen und Berater:innen digitale Lernprogramme, die Menschen über Wochen begleiten. Produziert wird mit einer eigenen KI-Kette: Strukturvorschläge, Kurse, Bilder, Stimmen, Übersetzungen. Was die KI nicht kann: verstehen, was ein Coach wirklich braucht, beurteilen, ob ein Programm wirkt, und es so bauen, dass es sich trägt. Dafür suchen wir dich. Die Nachfrage wächst gerade schneller, als unser Gründer allein Gespräche führen kann. Was du machst Du führst Erstgespräche mit Coaches und findest heraus, was sie wirklich brauchen. Wenn es nicht passt, sagst du es freundlich. Du hältst die Pipeline in Bewegung: viele Partner parallel, jeder mit klarem nächsten Schritt. Du prüfst, was unsere KI aus Gesprächen und Material erstellt (Strukturvorschläge, PDFs, Kurse), gibst ihr präzises Feedback und gibst frei, wenn es gut ist. Du besprichst die Ergebnisse mit den Partnern und entwickelst die Programme mit ihnen weiter. Du denkst Programme wirtschaftlich: Preis, Einstieg, Abo, Upgrade, und was Lernende dranhält. Nach dem Start schaust du, was funktioniert, und machst daraus die nächste Staffel. Was du mitbringst Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung oder Partner- und Kundenbetreuung mit eigener Verantwortung, gern in Coaching, Weiterbildung, EdTech oder SaaS. Du arbeitest strukturiert mit vielen Beteiligten gleichzeitig und lässt nichts liegen. Du rechnest gern nach, ob ein Modell trägt. Du weißt, wie Menschen lernen und dranbleiben; Erfahrung in L&D ist ein Plus, den Rest lernst du bei uns. Du erkennst, wenn ein Text oder Konzept nicht trägt, und kannst genau sagen, warum. Mit KI-Werkzeugen arbeitest du selbstverständlich. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch gut. Was wir bieten 70.000 bis 85.000 € brutto im Jahr in Vollzeit. Wenn du lieber vier Tage arbeitest, geht das auch, mit anteiligem Gehalt. 100 % remote, Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Keine Produktionsarbeit: Gespräche, Urteil, Programm

jobs.title: Chief Science Officer
jobs.description: Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾 Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time Who we are Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL. Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles. Why this role, why now Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. The Real-World Learning Loop is your system Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise: In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning. Continuous Data Acquisition. jobs.company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA,

The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. The UK is central to that story. Every conference, board meeting and live event our clients host relies on a finance team that keeps things moving behind the scenes. jobs.title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Die ÖDP Bayern sucht idealerweise ab Dezember 2026 einen Social Media Manager (m/w/d) für 15 Stunden pro Woche. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Bei uns geht es um Themen, die Bayern direkt betreffen: Natur und Umwelt, sauberes Wasser, Artenvielfalt, direkte Demokratie, Gemeinwohl und politische Unabhängigkeit. Und wir reden nicht nur über politische Veränderungen. Mit Volksbegehren bringen wir sie selbst auf den Weg. Die ÖDP hat „Rettet die Bienen“ initiiert, das mit rund 1,7 Millionen Unterstützerinnen und Unterstützern zum erfolgreichsten Volksbegehren in der Geschichte Bayerns wurde. Auch beim konsequenten Nichtraucherschutz und bei der Abschaffung des Bayerischen Senats spielte die ÖDP als Initiatorin von Volksbegehren eine zentrale Rolle. Aktuell läuft mit „Macht auf Zeit“ das nächste Volksbegehren zur Begrenzung der Amtszeit des bayerischen Ministerpräsidenten auf zehn Jahre. Das bedeutet für Deinen Job: starke Themen, echte Kampagnen, politische Debatten und jede Menge Stoff für guten Content. Was Du bei uns machst Du arbeitest remote oder in der Landesgeschäftsstelle in Passau und kannst bei wichtigen Terminen, Drehs und Aktionen in Bayern vor Ort sein. Du entwickelst und produzierst Content für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere Instagram und TikTok. Du drehst und schneidest Videos, entwickelst neue Formate und bereitest politische Themen so auf, dass sie verständlich, relevant und interessant werden. Du erkennst, welche Themen und Geschichten Potenzial haben, reagierst auf aktuelle Debatten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Presse- und Kommunikationsteam Redaktionspläne und Kampagnen. Du betreust unsere Community, analysierst Reichweiten und Formate und nutzt die Ergebnisse, um unsere Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Und Du bekommst Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir suchen niemanden, der einfach nur Posts abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Ideen entwickelt, Dinge ausprobiert und unsere Social-Media-Arbeit gemeinsam mit

jobs.title: Planungsingenieur (m/w/d) – Energieversorgung
jobs.description: Die Planung von Umspannwerken ist deine Leidenschaft – und du suchst einen Arbeitgeber, bei dem deine Expertise nicht im Tagesgeschäft untergeht? Dann bist Du bei EMIS genau richtig. Wir sind ein familiengeführtes, mittelständisches Unternehmen mit rund 350 Mitarbeitenden an 5 Standorten in Deutschland. Seit vielen Jahren setzen wir Maßstäbe in den Bereichen Elektrotechnik, Energieversorgung, Automatisierung und Robotik und gelten als zuverlässiger Partner für die Industrie von morgen. Für unseren EMIS-Standort in Lübbenau suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Planungsingenieur (m/w/d) für Energieversorgung zur unbefristeten Festanstellung. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst das Gesamtpaket von der Entwurfs- bis zur Ausführungsplanung für den Neu- und Umbau von Umspannwerken. Dabei entwickelst du Lösungen in der Sekundärtechnik für Mittel- und Hochspannungs-Umspannwerke. Du erstellst technische Konzepte und Planungsunterlagen (Stromlaufpläne, Klemmenpläne, Kabellisten, Montageunterlagen). Du wirkst an der Angebotserstellung und Begleitung von Projekten mit und stellst sicher, dass alle Normen, Vorschriften und Qualitätsanforderungen eingehalten werden Die enge Zusammenarbeit zwischen dir und den Montage- und Inbetriebnahmeteams sorgt für reibungslose Abläufe Du reportest an den Projektleiter zu Qualität, Kosten, Terminen und Zielen Das bieten wir dir Leistungsgerechte Vergütung - wir honorieren deine Arbeit nach Tarif. Sondergratifikationen - freu dich auf Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld sowie Jubiläumsgratifikationen. Diverse Mitarbeitervorteile - Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Krankenzusatzversicherung, Kita-Zuschuss, EMIS-Bike, Firmenfitness, Gesundheitsprogramme u.v.m. gehen auf unsere Kosten. Umfangreiche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten - wir fördern deine persönliche Entwicklung durch passende Bildungsangebote. Flache Hierarchien - unser familiäres Flair bietet dir einen wertschätzenden Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Strukturierte Einarbeitung - wir heißen dich willkommen

jobs.title: Technical Manager (North)
jobs.description: Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists. We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems. The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe. jobs.title: Senior Umwelt- und Raumplaner (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über uns Seit über 25 Jahren stehen wir von Terra Consulting GmbH für unabhängige und innovative Ingenieurdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Verkehr/Infrastruktur, Umwelt, Lagerstätten, Geotechnik, Flächenrecycling, Gebäudeschadstoffe und Altlasten für die Privatwirtschaft und für öffentliche Auftraggeber. Einen Schwerpunkt dabei bilden Projekte der Energiewende. An unseren Standorten in Dortmund und Bonn arbeiten wir mit über 30 Mitarbeitern. Unser Bonner Büro bietet ein breites Spektrum an umwelt- und naturschutzfachlichen Planungsleistungen an, u.a. die Analyse und Bewertung umweltrelevanter Eingriffe sowie die Erstellung von Anträgen und Fachgutachten. Unsere Überzeugungen spiegeln sich in unseren Leistungen wider. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen kooperativen Führungsstil, der auf gegenseitigem Respekt und ein offenes Ohr für neue Ideen basiert. Bei uns stehen die individuellen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven unserer Mitarbeiter im Vordergrund – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Alter. Als Team setzen wir auf ein faires und wertschätzendes Miteinander und offene Kommunikation untereinander, aber auch gegenüber unseren Kunden. Unsere Hauptauftraggeber sind neben den Lagerstättenbetreibern die Energieversorgungsunternehmen und die Straßen- und Eisenbahninfrastrukturunternehmen. Bei der Terra Consulting GmbH nimmst du aktiv an der Energiewende und dem Infrastrukturausbau teil. Wir schätzen unsere Traditionen, sind offen für Innovationen und entwickeln uns weiter. Möchtest du mitgestalten? Zur Stelle Welche Anlagenstandorte eignen sich für die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen? In unserem Projektteam mit fünf bis sechs Kollegen vergleichst du Alternativen und führst technische Anforderungen, Umweltbelange und raumplanerische Gesichtspunkte zu einer fundierten Bewertung zusammen. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The mission You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters. Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure. You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond. Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end. Location: On-site at one of our data center in Bessé-sur-Braye, Pays de la Loire. What you'll do Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs, and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand). Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas. Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on. Manage parts — receive, label

jobs.description: BetterHelp – Word onderdeel van het grootste online therapieplatform ter wereld! Bij BetterHelp hebben we als missie om barrières voor therapie weg te nemen en geestelijke gezondheidszorg voor iedereen toegankelijk te maken. Gespecialiseerde cliëntgroepen: Richt u op de gebieden waar u het meest gepassioneerd over bent. Geen overheadkosten: Er worden nooit kosten in rekening gebracht bij de counselor. BetterHelp respecteert uw klinische oordeel en expertise om de meest effectieve en geschikte aanpak voor elke cliënt te bepalen. Ondersteuning en hulpmiddelen: Counselors op het BetterHelp-platform ontvangen gratis toegang tot een BetterHelp-account – zodat u ook tijd kunt besteden aan uw eigen welzijn! Concurrerende vergoeding en bonussen: Verdien €500 wanneer u uw eerste cliënt binnen 14 dagen na aanmelding accepteert. Voor wie is dit van toepassing: Counselors die flexibiliteit zoeken om teletherapie vanaf elke locatie te geven. Counselors die zich willen richten op klinisch werk—wij nemen de werving van cliënten, facturatie en ondersteuning

jobs.title: Release Manager - AI Models
jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Our engineering teams bring together ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to turn breakthrough autonomous-driving technology into reliable products. Model releases connect these disciplines, taking AI models from early hypotheses through training, evaluation, and on-road testing to deployment across our vehicle fleet. As our Release Manager — AI Models, you’ll help ensure that a core part of our technology — the AI model — is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production. You’ll bring structure and disciplined release practices to the fast-paced, non-deterministic world of ML, building the processes and systems that support clarity, stability, and business goals. 🧠 Your day-to-day Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence while adapting to changing business priorities. Coordinate across ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product to keep releases moving and resolve dependencies. Run the gates that promote models from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment, making clear what is ready to ship and what needs more work. Drive investigations into regressions and integration issues, coordinate rollback or roll-forward decisions, and follow through on technical debt and corrective actions. Be the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, giving engineers and leadership the right level of detail. Run post-release reviews and turn lessons learned into practical improvements across teams. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Release gate

jobs.title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. Based in Bristol, UK, you’ll develop board and PCBA hardware tests that help turn complex designs into reliable products. You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en problèmes publics des centres de données pour rejoindre le département de recherche Sciences Économiques et Sociales (SES) et plus particulièrement la chaire SHS TerraAINs. Contexte scientifique : La Chaire SHS TerrAINs s’intéresse aux enjeux territoriaux du développement des infrastructures numériques et plus particulièrement des centres de données en France. Elle est portée par Pauline Gourlet et financée par la Région Ile de France (2026-2029). Longtemps demeurés une infrastructure invisible, les centres de données ( data centers ) se trouvent désormais au cœur des problématiques des politiques publiques et industrielles et la Région Ile de France concentre aujourd’hui ces infrastructures (plus de 165 en 2024), avec de nombreux projets de data centers hyperscale à l’étude. tags: ingénierie et services de la santé
jobs.description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet ANR-DFG 3DFaceBias , qui vise à mesurer, expliquer et réduire les écarts de précision dans la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir de photographies 2D, nous recrutons un Post-doctorat en évaluation et réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D au sein de notre département Data Science sur le campus de Brest. Vous piloterez les travaux d’IMT Atlantique sur l’évaluation et la réduction des biais en reconstruction faciale 3D avec pour principales missions : Auditer les biais de la reconstruction faciale 3D à partir d'images 2D. Identifier les sources de biais par une analyse centrée sur les données. Concevoir et évaluer des stratégies centrées sur les données pour atténuer les biais. Contribuer aux activités transverses du projet. Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Vous avez une solide expérience en recherche expérimentale et en méthodes statistiques avancées. Votre expertise inclut la conception d’expériences contrôlées, l’évaluation des incertitudes, la gestion des facteurs de confusion, ainsi que la prévention des fuites d’information (data leakage). ✔️ Maîtrisant Python et un framework comme PyTorch, vous savez modifier, tester et déboguer du code de recherche avec efficacité. Vos compétences couvrent des domaines clés tels que : Vision par ordinateur, reconstruction 3D et géométrie 3D, Modèles statistiques de forme ou informatique médicale, Équité algorithmique, robustesse, généralisation et génération de données synthétiques. ✔️ Vous excellez dans l’évaluation des performances et des biais, via des analyses par sous-groupes, l’interprétation des disparités et un examen rigoureux des limites. Une expérie

jobs.description: Installation, formation et support des solutions d’encaissement Vous aimez le contact client, les nouvelles technologies et les solutions concrètes ? Rejoignez SAS ARCHIMAX pour accompagner les restaurateurs et les commerçants dans la prise en main de leurs outils digitaux. Votre mission : offrir une expérience client de qualité, de l’installation des équipements à leur utilisation au quotidien. Qui sommes-nous ? SAS ARCHIMAX est spécialisée dans l’installation et la maintenance de systèmes de caisse, d’équipements digitaux et de réseaux, notamment autour du logiciel RESTOMAX. Nous aidons les professionnels de la restauration et du commerce à simplifier leur quotidien et à digitaliser leur activité. Pour accompagner notre développement, nous recherchons une personne qui associe sens du service, curiosité technique et envie de transmettre. Vos missions Après une formation interne à nos solutions, vous intervenez sur site et à distance, avec l’appui de techniciens expérimentés. Accompagner et former nos clients Guider les clients dans la découverte et la prise en main de leurs solutions. Les former à l’utilisation de RESTOMAX avec des explications claires, adaptées à leurs besoins. Répondre à leurs questions et les aider à utiliser leurs équipements avec confiance et autonomie. jobs.title: IT Servicedesk Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description: Make technology work for everyone At Sunweb Group, technology plays a key role in delivering unforgettable holiday experiences to more than 1.3 million customers every year. Behind the scenes, our colleagues rely on secure, reliable, and user-friendly IT solutions to do their best work. As an IT Servicedesk Engineer (Senior), you are the first point of contact for employees across our international organization. From resolving technical issues and supporting new joiners to improving processes and maintaining our digital workplace, you make sure colleagues can work efficiently and without disruption. You'll join our IT team in Rotterdam and collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, and development specialists to provide an excellent employee experience. Location: Rotterdam Start Date: ASAP Availability: Full-time Your impact In this role, you'll support colleagues across our international organisation, different hub offices and business functions. You'll combine hands-on IT support with ownership and continuous improvement, acting as a trusted point of contact for both colleagues and stakeholders. Depending on your experience, you'll also take the lead in specific areas of expertise, support less experienced colleagues and contribute to improving and automating our IT processes. Responsibilities Resolve first- and second-line IT incidents and service requests through Jira, phone, email and walk-ins. Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, VPN, Microsoft 365 and workplace-related issues. Support onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, permissions, access and device setup. Make sure new colleagues have the right tools and systems available from day one. Manage and maintain user accounts, devices and workplace applications. Act as an escalation point for more complex incidents and service requests. Work closely with Infrastructure, Security and Development teams to resolve technical issues. Contribute to ITIL-based service management processes

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: About Shiftbase We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way. We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro. About the role You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual. Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt. Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time. You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human. Year one, in order First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release. Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself. Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. jobs.description: Dit is Shiftbase Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn. Wat ga je doen? Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten. Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek. jobs.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
jobs.description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling. This is a remote opportunity. What You'll Do Own call quality holistically : hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments. Manage zones, codes, and origins : own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones. Update routing continuously : change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers. jobs.title: Senior Acquisition Marketeer
jobs.description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number. As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist. Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is. What you’ll do Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most. Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor. Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone. jobs.description: About FoodLabs FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Expenses Team
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role End-to-end expense automation: You’d work on a web app, and the BLP company card, where receipts are captured, read by AI (OCR and agents), matched to card transactions, and posted to the customer’s ERP with minimal manual effort. ERP integrations and card infrastructure: We’re building interfaces to systems such as SAP, F&O, and proAlpha, along with multi-currency, fee, and tip booking logic and card transaction processing via our card partner. Market expansion: We’re rolling out in Switzerland from early 2027 and in Germany from Q3 2027, which means new capabilities such as per diem allowances and kilometer expenses. What’s next: Travel management integrations are planned for 2027, with automatic expense creation from bookings, handling of trip changes and cancellations, and consolidated travel reporting. jobs.description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: Firefox Enterprise is a new team within Mozilla addressing the needs of business and government customers for a secure enterprise browser that gives organizations greater control over their data, policies, and digital infrastructure. We are seeking a Strategic Partnerships Manager to help build and grow the Firefox Enterprise partner ecosystem France. You will build and develop strategic partnerships and alliances across the French technology, public-sector, cloud, open-source, and systems-integration ecosystem. jobs.description: Kami sedang mencari Accounting & Tax yang teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai accounting dan perpajakan untuk mendukung pengelolaan keuangan perusahaan. Posisi ini memiliki cakupan pekerjaan yang cukup luas, meliputi accounting, perpajakan, rekonsiliasi, serta pelaporan keuangan. Meskipun demikian, volume transaksi accounting relatif tidak tinggi. Tanggung Jawab Melakukan pencatatan transaksi dan jurnal umum. Melakukan rekonsiliasi kas, bank, AP, dan AR. Mengelola petty cash dan administrasi keuangan. Membantu penyusunan laporan keuangan secara berkala. Melakukan perhitungan dan pelaporan PPh 21, PPh 23, PPh 4(2), dan PPN. Mengelola administrasi perpajakan melalui Coretax. Melakukan rekonsiliasi data accounting dan perpajakan. Membantu proses SPT Tahunan Badan. Menyiapkan data dan laporan keuangan yang dibutuhkan oleh manajemen. Melakukan tugas administrasi atau pekerjaan lain yang berkaitan dengan accounting dan tax apabila diperlukan. Kualifikasi Minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, Perpajakan, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman 1-3 tahun di bidang Accounting & Tax. Memahami dasar-dasar accounting dan perpajakan. Menguasai Microsoft Excel. Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan software accounting menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami penggunaan Coretax menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, rapi, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki perhatian terhadap detail. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemauan untuk belajar dan berkembang.

jobs.description: Job Description: Melaksanakan seluruh aktivitas finance, accounting, dan perpajakan. Melakukan pencatatan transaksi keuangan dilakukan secara akurat, tepat waktu, dan sesuai standar akuntansi yang berlaku. Menyusun dan mereview laporan keuangan secara rutin. Mengelola arus kas (cash flow), pengendalian biaya, serta perencanaan keuangan perusahaan. Bertanggung jawab atas perhitungan, pemotongan, penyetoran, dan pelaporan pajak, khususnya PPh 21, serta pajak lainnya (PPh 23, PPh 25/29, PPN). Membuat laporan SPT bulanan, PPn dan SPT Tahunan Badan Memahami terkait AP & AR Melakukan rekonsiliasi Bank Memastikan kepatuhan perusahaan terhadap peraturan perpajakan dan keuangan yang berlaku. Berkoordinasi dengan pihak eksternal seperti kantor pajak, auditor, konsultan pajak, dan bank. Mendukung proses audit internal maupun eksternal. Kualifikasi / Kriteria: Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, Ekonomi, atau Perpajakan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai staff di bidang Finance, Accounting & Tax. Wajib memahami dan menguasai PPh 21, termasuk perhitungan, pelaporan, dan regulasi terbaru. Memahami dasar perpajakan lain seperti PPh 23, PPh Badan, dan PPN menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu menyusun dan menganalisis laporan keuangan. Terbiasa menggunakan software akuntansi (accurate, odoo, zahir), pajak (coretax) dan Microsoft Excel (pivot, vlookup, dll). Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan problem solving yang baik. Teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja dengan target serta deadline. Bersedia ditempatkan di Pandaan, Pasuruan.

jobs.title: Chef De Partie (CDP)
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Memimpin, mengawasi, dan bertanggung jawab penuh atas operasional station dapur tertentu agar kualitas hidangan konsisten. Memastikan semua makanan disajikan sesuai standar resep, presentasi, porsi, dan tingkat kematangan sebelum diantarkan ke pelanggan (Quality Control). Melakukan persiapan (prep work) bahan makanan berstandar tinggi serta mengolah menu utama pada jam operasional, terutama saat jam sibuk (rush hour). Memantau ketersediaan stok bahan di station-nya, melakukan pencatatan bahan masuk/keluar (FIFO), dan membuat daftar permintaan bahan baku (groceries list) kepada Head Chef/Kitchen Manager. Mengontrol dan memastikan penerapan standar kebersihan, kebersihan alat, serta keselamatan kerja (HACCP/Food Safety) di area dapur. Membimbing dan mengarahkan staf dapur yang bertugas di station-nya agar bekerja secara efisien dan rapi. Kriteria & Kualifikasi Minimal SMA/SMK Tata Boga, D3/S1 Pariwisata/Perhotelan/Seni Kuliner lebih disukai. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai CDP atau minimal 3 tahun sebagai Demis Chef / Senior Cook di cafe, restoran skala medium-large, atau hotel. Menguasai teknik memasak (culinary skills) yang baik, memahami kontrol porsi (portion control), serta memiliki pengetahuan kuat tentang kalkulasi bahan (food cost). Memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan (leadership), komunikasi yang baik, dan mampu mengambil keputusan cepat saat situasi dapur padat. Disiplin tinggi, detail terhadap rasa & estetika makanan, serta mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan (stress management). Berdomisili di Pandaan, Pasuruan atau sekitarnya. Penyesuaian bentuk hukum menjadi Persero, dinyatakan dalam Akta No. 131, tanggal 31 Juli 1992, dibuat di hadapan Muhani Salim, S.H., yang telah diumumkan dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia No. 73 tanggal 11 September 1992 Tambahan No. 1A.
